Package edu.cnu.mdi.splot.pdata

Class PlotData

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.pdata.PlotData
All Implemented Interfaces:
CurveChangeListener, EventListener
public class PlotData extends Object implements CurveChangeListener
A lightweight, UI-agnostic container for the data backing a plot.

PlotData owns one or more ACurve instances (including histogram-backed curves such as HistoCurve, and ordinary XY curves such as Curve). Views typically register a single DataChangeListener on the PlotData and repaint when notified.

Notifications

There are two kinds of changes:
  • Structural changes to the model (curves added/removed/cleared) — fired by PlotData.
  • Data changes within a curve (points appended, histogram filled, etc.) — fired by the curve, and forwarded by PlotData so the view can listen in one place.

Threading

PlotData is not synchronized. If curves are updated from a background sampler (e.g. StripChartCurve), the view should use its existing snapshot/copy strategy when rendering.

Thread-safety

PlotData is not thread-safe. All structural mutations (addCurve(edu.cnu.mdi.splot.pdata.ACurve)) and all listener notifications MUST be called on the Swing EDT. Background producers should call only the thread-safe methods on the individual ACurve subclasses (e.g. Curve.add(double, double), Curve.enqueue(double, double)) — never mutate PlotData directly from off-EDT threads.

  • Constructor Details

    • PlotData

      public PlotData(HistoData... histos) throws PlotDataException
      Create plot data from one or more 1D histogram data objects. Each HistoData is wrapped in a HistoCurve and added to this model.
      Parameters:
      histos - one or more histogram data objects (must be non-null and contain no nulls)
      Throws:
      PlotDataException - if there is a problem creating the data set

    • PlotData

      public PlotData(Histo2DData histo2D) throws PlotDataException
      Create plot data for a 2D histogram.
      Parameters:
      histo2D - the 2D histogram backing data (non-null)
      Throws:
      PlotDataException - if the histogram data is null

    • PlotData

      public PlotData(StripChartCurve stripData) throws PlotDataException
      Create plot data for a strip chart (time series / streamed XY).
      Parameters:
      stripData - the strip chart backing data (non-null)
      Throws:
      PlotDataException - if the strip data does not provide a curve

    • PlotData

      public PlotData(PlotDataType type, String[] curveNames, int[] fitOrders) throws PlotDataException
      Create plot data with specified data set type and column names.
      Parameters:
      type - the data set type (non-null)
      curveNames - a curve is created for each curve name. Must be non-null and contain at least one name. The names should not be null.
      fitOrders - optional fit orders for each curve (may be null). If non-null, the length must match the number of curve names. This fit orders are assigned to each curve via ACurve.setFitOrder(int). They are only relevant for MultiGaussian (no. of Gaussians) and Polynomial (polynomial degree) fits.
      Throws:
      PlotDataException - if there is a problem creating the data set
